tha-ap502:1.1: Piyālaphaladāyaka.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ vīcine vicaran tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ. // //
tha-ap502:2.1: Piyālaphalam ādāya Buddhaseṭṭhass' adās' ahaṃ / puññakkhettassa vīrassa pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap502:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap502:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Piyālaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap502:10.1: Kiṅkhani-Paṃsukūlañ ca Koraṇḍapupphi Kiṃsukhaṃ Upaḍḍhadussī Ghatado Udakaṃ-Thūpakārako
tha-ap502:11.1: Naḷāgārī ca navamo Piyālaphaladāyako sataṃ ekañ ca gāthānaṃ navakañ ca taduttariṃ. Kiṅkhanipupphiyavaggo paññāso. Atha vaggUddānaṃ:
tha-ap502:13.1: Metteyya-Bhaddālivaggo Sakiṃsammajjako pi ca eko Vibheṭakī vaggo Jagati Sālapupphiyo
tha-ap502:14.1: Naḷamālaṃ Paṃsukūlaṃ Kiṅkhaṇipupphiyo tadā asīti dve ca gāthāyo catuddasasatāni ca.
